description: This file defines a React functional component for a role comparison page within a learning and competency management application. It handles fetching roles, competencies, gap analysis, and recommended learning resources, displaying an interactive interface allowing users to select roles and view comparative data.

methods.name: difficultyScore
methods.description: Converts textual difficulty levels into numeric scores for comparison and ranking purposes.

methods.name: fmtLevel
methods.description: Formats numeric proficiency levels into human-readable strings like F, P, A, AU.

methods.name: competencyNameForId
methods.description: Retrieves the competency name corresponding to a given ID from a list of competencies.

methods.name: StatusPill
methods.description: React component that displays a color-coded badge indicating competency gap status.
